environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'data-pipeline' with service account 'stream-processor-sa'. Pod has network access to Kafka brokers on port 9092. The /etc/keys/jwt_public.pem is mounted from a ConfigMap. The Kafka cluster has no ACLs configured - any authenticated client can produce to any topic including 'admin-commands'. The pod's IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/StreamProcessorRole) has kafka:* permissions with no permission boundary attached.
